text.p: LXR Biotechnology Inc said Wednesday it signed an agreement with Boehringer Mannheim Group to jointly evaluate the potential of Maspin, a naturally occurring protein, to treat breast cancer and prostate cancer.
LXR is the exclusive licensee of the patented technology covering Maspin, thought to suppress tumors in breast tissue.
Specific terms of the agreement were not disclosed, but LXR said the companies would jointly assess Maspin's role in the development of tumors and their metastasis.
LXR said it would conduct toxicity studies with Maspin and tumor inhibition studies with the naturally-occuring human Maspin in mice.
If the joint assessment was successful, LXR said it would receive research funding, milestone payments and a royalty fee upon commercialization.
LXR also said it received a Phase I grant from the Small Business Innovation Research Program to evaluate Maspin's role as a tumor suppressor for various other cancers.
Boehringer is high-technology healthcare company which is part of privately-held Corange Ltd.
